itens.trecho: Entretém, e por vezes é divertido, mas se fosse mais dramático teria funcionado ainda melhor. Confesso que não fiquei muito impressionado com este filme. Apresentado como um drama no espaço, eu pensei que seria algo mais tenso do que é.

This is a movie that I have to say that I have a bit of a difficulty in rating. Quite honestly I was sorely tempted to remove a star, or even two stars. Why? Because it is full of Hollywood nonsense, scientific errors, it is rather predictable and it did feel a bit like a Apollo 13 rip-off. Why did I not remove those stars?

Review contains spoilers --- You have been warned. --- One of the movies I just can't stop rewatching because of how good I think it is, the movie contains facts that can excite a wide array of audience, since it tackles many categories from action to adventure to science and astrophysics, the movie has most if not many elements related to one of these…
